name: GREENYB
recent: 公司近期进行了股份回购，并因可赎回可转换优先股转换为新股而增加已发行股本。董事Voon Sze Lin在公开市场增持股份，同时公司发布了季度生产数据。
notable: 公司通过可赎回可转换优先股转换发行了11,947,471股新股，上市日期为2026年10月2日。
董事Voon Sze Lin在公开市场增持股份，包括2026年9月10日收购229,000股和2026年10月2日收购53,200股。
公司进行了股份回购，最近一次在2026年11月20日。
risks: 董事Voon Sze Lin在公开市场增持股份，导致其直接和间接持股比例发生变化。
公司进行了股份回购，可能影响股本结构。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from preference share conversion

recent_en: The company recently conducted share buybacks and increased its issued share capital due to the conversion of irredeemable convertible preference shares into new ordinary shares. Director Voon Sze Lin acquired shares in the open market, and the company released quarterly production figures.
notable_en: The company issued 11,947,471 new shares via conversion of irredeemable convertible preference shares, with listing date on 2 October 2026.
Director Voon Sze Lin acquired shares in the open market, including 229,000 shares on 10 September 2026 and 53,200 shares on 2 October 2026.
The company conducted share buybacks, with the latest on 20 November 2026.
risks_en: Director Voon Sze Lin acquired shares in the open market, resulting in changes to his direct and indirect shareholding percentages.
The company conducted share buybacks, which may affect its share capital structure.
